- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The USDA sets standards for food quality and safety, including organic food standards.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The USDA's Agricultural Research Service (ARS) conducts research to improve food safety technologies and practices.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The USDA provides education and outreach to consumers and food industry professionals about food safety risks and handling.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The USDA takes a comprehensive approach to food safety, working to prevent foodborne illnesses at every stage of food production.
